findings.title: The reviewed state does not contain the PRD-3672 change: offerAccepted sends no section on either offer page
findings.body:
The scoped range 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f is not the 10-file PRD-3672 change. HEAD (6fbfb05e2f) is four partner-preview commits on merge-base 79810ee497. Those commits touch only partner-profile and Partner dashboard files, 13 files in all. The base 4bdce06aa7 (PRD-3663/3666, #6813) is not an ancestor of HEAD; it is 88 commits further along main. The two-dot diff therefore spans 1090 files (+45,913/−89,634), and no commit for PRD-3672 is reachable.

On HEAD, `press()` builds `accepted = { offerKey, company?, amazonStoreKey? }` with no `section` (amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:486-495; the checkup page matches). So presses on the ticket, the store block and the close band cannot be told apart. `CTA_SECTIONS`, `CtaSection` and `ctaAttrs` do not exist in site.ts on HEAD, and the Start buttons carry no `data-cta-section`. The test at amazon-scorecard-offer.test.ts:719-724 asserts the payload without `section`.

Every condition the change is meant to meet fails on this state, so the reported green test and typecheck result cannot belong to it. The ctaClicked and CTA-naming removals that appear in the two-dot diff are an artifact of the base being ahead on main: no commit on HEAD's line removes them.
findings.fix: Point the review at the real prd-3672-offer-page-name tip, diffed from its merge-base with main (`git diff $(git merge-base main <tip>)..<tip>`), and rerun the tests there. On both pages, pass the pressed button's section (ticket / hero / close-band) into offerAccepted.

findings.title: offerAccepted не указывает нажатую кнопку

Проблема существовала до сравниваемого изменения; заявленная цель на проверенном HEAD не реализована.
findings.fix: Добавить секции ticket, hero и close-band к соответствующим кнопкам и передавать секцию нажатой кнопки в offerAccepted на обеих страницах.

findings.title: The reviewed state does not contain the PRD-3672 change: offerAccepted sends no section and CTA_SECTIONS does not exist
findings.body: The scope says the change adds `section` (from `data-cta-section`) to `offerAccepted` and a `ticket` entry to `CTA_SECTIONS`. The range it gives, 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f, is two diverged branches with merge-base 79810ee497. HEAD (6fbfb05e2f) holds four partner-preview commits ('Lock partner preview readiness handshake' and others). 4bdce06aa7 is PRD-3663 (#6813) plus 87 other commits. The diff touches 1090 files and, in console/components/marketing, takes `data-cta-section` and `ctaAttrs` out instead of adding to them. On HEAD, `press()` builds `accepted = { offerKey, company?, amazonStoreKey? }` with no `section` (amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:488-495), and `console/components/marketing/site.ts` has no `CTA_SECTIONS` or `ctaAttrs`. No commit on any branch adds `'ticket'` to site.ts (`git log --all -S"'ticket'" -- site.ts` is empty), and there is no prd-3672 branch. So every 'correct only if' condition fails on the reviewed state. If this range ships as the PR, the gift ticket, store block and closing band all send `offerAccepted` with no `section`, and PRD-3663's ctaClicked section naming is reverted across the public pages. The supplied '406 tests green' result therefore cannot apply to this tree.
findings.fix: Check out the actual prd-3672-offer-page-name commit, or rebase the PRD-3672 work onto 4bdce06aa7, and run the review again on that state.

findings.title: offerAccepted не содержит section на обеих страницах

Это существовало до рассматриваемого диапазона: исходный обработчик тоже не добавлял section, поэтому заявленный контракт изменения не выполнен.

findings.fix: Восстановить общий обработчик и разметку CTA, указав для кнопок предложения секции ticket, hero и close-band.

findings.title: The reviewed HEAD (6fbfb05e2f) does not contain the PRD-3672 change, and the scoped range reverts PRD-3663
findings.body:
The scope names branch `prd-3672-offer-page-name`, "10 files changed, 114 insertions(+), 14 deletions(-)". The scope's own command, `git diff 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f`, gives "1090 files changed, 45913 insertions(+), 89634 deletions(-)" instead.

The base 4bdce06aa7 (PRD-3663, #6813) is 88 commits ahead of HEAD. `git merge-base` returns 79810ee497. HEAD is a partner-preview commit ("fix: remove eager partner preview post") with no PRD-3672 work. `git log --all --grep=3672` finds no branch commit.

On HEAD, none of the goal's "correct only if" conditions hold:
- `press()` in amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:488-495 builds `accepted = { offerKey, company?, amazonStoreKey? }` with no `section`. The same is true of amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:~508. So a gift-ticket, store-block or close-band press sends no `section`.

If this range ships as reviewed, the PRD-3663 CTA tracking regresses and the feature is still missing. The reported "406 tests green / typecheck exit 0" results cannot belong to the described change, because it is not in this tree.
findings.fix: Re-point the review at the real `prd-3672-offer-page-name` head, whose merge-base should be 4bdce06aa7, and re-run the diff. Do not open the PR from 6fbfb05e2f.

findings.body: Observed: HEAD 6fbfb05e2f (detached; commits are partner-preview work) has merge-base 79810ee497 with the base 4bdce06aa7 (PRD-3663/3666 #6813), so base..HEAD is not the 10-file PRD-3672 change but a ~9.6MB diff that, in the marketing area, reverts #6813. The gift ticket (scorecard ~:194, checkup ~:195) and the store block (~:246) carry no `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` attributes at all. `CTA_SECTIONS`/`ctaAttrs` do not exist in site.ts, and there is no `ticket` value. The scorecard test at amazon-scorecard-offer.test.ts:738 still expects `['offerAccepted', { offerKey, amazonStoreKey }, ...]` with no section.

Every 'correct only if' criterion in the goal (ticket→`ticket`, store→`hero`, closing band→`close-band`, `ticket` a valid CtaSection, docs matching) fails on this state. The '406 tests green / typecheck exit 0' evidence cannot cover the described change, because that change is not in this tree.
findings.fix: Check out the actual prd-3672-offer-page-name branch (rebased on 4bdce06aa7 or later) and re-run the review and its checks against it.

findings.title: The base..HEAD range rolls back #6813's CTA naming (CTA_NAMES, CTA_SECTIONS, ctaAttrs, data-cta attributes) and the public-pages analytics docs
findings.body:
HEAD forked before the base commit 4bdce06aa7 (PRD-3663/3666 #6813, 'Name every call-to-action click'). So the scoped diff `git diff 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f` deletes, among much else (hundreds of files, including .contracts/reasons, for-experts.tsx and stepper.tsx):
- `BOOK_CALL_PLACEMENTS`, `CTA_NAMES`, `CTA_SECTIONS` and `ctaAttrs` from site.ts:121-153
- the `section` parameter of `contactEmailHtml`
- every `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` on the offer pages' blocked-notice, gift-ticket and store-block links, plus the `ctaName` fields on the close-band primaries (amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:837,843; amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:832)
- the 'Public pages' and 'Scroll depth' sections of internal-dev-doc/posthog-session-replay.md, which document `ctaClicked {cta, section, page, href}` and `offerAccepted`

If this range ships as a patch (cherry-pick or squash of the diff), `ctaClicked` loses its names and sections on these pages, and the docs agents read for the PostHog funnel lose the event list. Merging HEAD's own commits through a normal 3-way merge would not cause this. The problem is that the range under review is not the intended change.
findings.fix: Rebase the PRD-3672 branch onto main at or after 4bdce06aa7, then regenerate the diff so it holds only the ~10 intended files.

findings.title: The range removes the ctaClicked click/auxclick handler from the public pages
findings.body:
The range deletes `ctaClickHandler` and its click/auxclick listeners from POSTHOG_SCRIPT, which sit at document.tsx:100–102 in base 4bdce06. It also strips the CTA markup from both offer pages and the closed lists from site.ts.

Autocapture is set to `false`, so pressing Start no longer sends `ctaClicked` at all. This is a regression the range introduces, and it breaks the scope's requirement that `ctaClicked` keep working with the ticket/hero sections.
findings.fix: Restore the ctaClicked handler, the CTA markup and the types. Add `ticket` to CTA_SECTIONS and give the buttons the required sections (ticket, hero, close-band).

findings.title: offerAccepted по-прежнему не содержит section на обеих страницах
findings.body: При действующем предложении вне preview обработчик формирует accepted только из offerKey, company и amazonStoreKey. Кнопки билета, магазина и нижнего блока отправляют одинаковый набор свойств; определить нажатую кнопку невозможно. То же происходит в amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504–508. Отсутствие section существовало до изменения, но осталось неисправленным вопреки явному контракту goal.md: ticket, hero и close-band для соответствующих кнопок.
findings.fix: На обеих страницах добавить в accepted поле section из data-cta-section нажатой кнопки и обеспечить значения ticket, hero и close-band в разметке.

findings.title: The reviewed range has no PRD-3672 change; it reverts the CTA instrumentation from #6813 and much of main
findings.body:
The scope command is `git diff 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f`, but 4bdce06aa7 (PRD-3663/3666, #6813) is not an ancestor of HEAD. The merge-base is 79810ee497. HEAD is a detached side line of four partner-preview commits, and `git log 6fbfb05e2f..4bdce06aa7` lists 88 main commits that HEAD lacks.

The diff therefore changes about 1090 files (+45913/−89634), not the 10 files (+114/−14) the scope describes. Restricted to the marketing paths it is 44 files, +623/−4143.

What this range deletes:
- From `site.ts`: `CTA_NAMES`, `CTA_SECTIONS`, `CtaSection`, `ctaAttrs` and `BOOK_CALL_PLACEMENTS`, plus the `section` parameter and the `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` attributes of `contactEmailHtml`. No `'ticket'` entry exists anywhere.
- From both offer pages: every `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` attribute and the close-band `ctaName` fields.
- Whole pages and components such as `for-experts.tsx` (−1171) and stepper.tsx.
- Tests: `job.top-cta.test.ts`, `jobs.test.ts`, most of `marketing-render.test.ts` and `document.test.ts`. The offer-test regexes are loosened so they no longer assert CTA attributes.
- From `internal-dev-doc/posthog-session-replay.md`: the Public pages and Scroll depth sections, which document `ctaClicked {cta, section, page, href}`, `offerAccepted` and others. SKILL.md also gets unrelated churn.

If the range ships as a patch (squash or cherry-pick), `ctaClicked` names and sections disappear from production pages and the PRD-3672 property is still missing. The supplied "406 tests green / typecheck 0" evidence cannot belong to this tree: tests it relies on, such as EXPECTED_CTA_SECTIONS, exist only at the base.
findings.fix: Point the review and the PR at the actual `prd-3672-offer-page-name` commit, rebased onto 4bdce06aa7 or a later main, and regenerate the diff so it holds only the ~10 intended files. Do not ship 6fbfb05e2f against this base.

findings.title: The tests that would catch lost CTA markup are deleted
findings.body:
The range deletes `marks every tracked marketing interaction as a CTA` and `has its approved CTA identity`, which check `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` and the table of button identities. Nothing replaces them.

In the same diff, both offer pages lose their CTA attributes and document.tsx loses the ctaClicked handler. The first deleted test would have flagged `[data-offer-go]` buttons that have no CTA name. The remaining check only compares the HTML with the components, so it accepts markup that is broken consistently in both. That is lost coverage of a concrete regression, and it contradicts the requirement to keep `ctaClicked` intact.
findings.fix: Restore the CTA markup tests, update the expected sections to ticket, hero and close-band, and keep a test that ctaClicked is sent on press.

findings.title: The reviewed range is inverted and HEAD has none of PRD-3672: `offerAccepted` still has no `section` and `ticket` is not in `CTA_SECTIONS`
findings.body:
What I observed: `git diff 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f`, the command named in scope.md, touches 1090 files (+45913 / −89634), not the 10 files the scope describes. Their merge-base is 79810ee497. Base 4bdce06aa7 is main at PRD-3663/3666 (#6813, 88 commits past the merge-base). HEAD 6fbfb05e2f is a detached side line of 4 'partner preview' commits. No commit reachable from any ref mentions PRD-3672 for this work.

At HEAD:
- `amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:491` builds `var accepted = { offerKey: key }` with only `company` and `amazonStoreKey` added. No `data-cta-section` is read and no `section` is sent. `amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504` is the same.
- `console/components/marketing/` has no `CTA_SECTIONS`, `CtaSection` or `ctaAttrs`. The range diff deletes them from `site.ts`, along with `CTA_NAMES`, `BOOK_CALL_PLACEMENTS` and the `data-cta` attributes in `contactEmailHtml`.
- Neither `.claude/skills/offer-pages/SKILL.md` nor `internal-dev-doc/posthog-session-replay.md` mentions `offerAccepted`.

What follows from that: none of the goal's 'correct only if' items holds on the reviewed state. No button sends `ticket` / `hero` / `close-band`, `ticket` is not a valid `CtaSection`, and the docs don't describe the event. The 'Already verified on HEAD' results (406 tests, typecheck) can't cover PRD-3672 code, because this tree has none. Shipping this range as a PR would not add the feature. It would undo 88 commits of main, including PRD-3663's CTA naming, and the checks would still look green.
findings.fix: Point the review at the real `prd-3672-offer-page-name` commit, with base = its merge-base with main (e.g. `git diff $(git merge-base main <branch>)..<branch>`). Re-run the tests and typecheck on that commit before deciding whether it ships.

findings.title: Удалён обработчик отправки ctaClicked
findings.body: Указанный диапазон удаляет из POSTHOG_SCRIPT обработчики click и auxclick для ctaClicked. При autocapture:false нажатие CTA больше не отправляет это событие. Одновременно из обеих offer-страниц удалены data-cta и data-cta-section. Это введённая диапазоном регрессия: требование сохранить ctaClicked не выполнено.
findings.fix: Восстановить обработчики и CTA-атрибуты, назначив кнопкам секции ticket, hero и close-band.

findings.title: offerAccepted по-прежнему отправляется без section
findings.body: В проверенном HEAD объект accepted содержит только offerKey и необязательные company и amazonStoreKey. Нажатия ticket, hero и close-band дают неразличимые события. В amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504–508 действует тот же код. Отсутствие section существовало и в базе; указанный диапазон не реализует основное требование PRD-3672. Существующие тесты также ожидают payload без section.
findings.fix: На обеих страницах добавить в accepted поле section из нажатого элемента и обеспечить предусмотренные значения атрибутов.

findings.title: The auxclick handler accepts right-clicks and records a false offerAccepted
findings.body:
This exists on both offer pages and was not introduced by the change. `press` listens to `auxclick` without checking `event.button`.

A right-click on a valid offer's button passes the state check, saves setup and sends `offerAccepted`, even though the visitor only opened a context menu. That adds false acceptances to the funnel.
findings.fix: Before saving setup and sending the event, ignore an auxclick whose `event.button !== 1`.

findings.title: Reviewed HEAD is a stale partner-preview branch; the scoped diff reverts 88 main commits including PRD-3663 CTA naming
findings.body: HEAD 6fbfb05e2f is not the PRD-3672 branch. Its four commits since the merge-base are 'Lock partner preview note contract', 'fix: explain partner profile preview state', 'Lock partner preview readiness handshake' and 'fix: remove eager partner preview post'. Its merge-base with the base 4bdce06aa7 is 79810ee497, and `git log 6fbfb05e2f..4bdce06aa7` lists 88 commits that HEAD does not have. The scope's command, `git diff 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f`, therefore produces 1090 files changed, +45913/−89634, not the 10 files / +114/−14 that scope.md describes. Shipping this tree on top of the base would undo all 88 commits. Among them is PRD-3663 (#6813), which this feature depends on. In site.ts it deletes `CTA_NAMES`, `CTA_SECTIONS`, `CtaSection` and `ctaAttrs`, plus `BOOK_CALL_PLACEMENTS`. In amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx and amazon-checkup-offer.tsx it strips every `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` attribute. It deletes for-experts.tsx (−1171), stepper.tsx, job.top-cta.test.ts and jobs.test.ts. It removes most of marketing-render.test.ts (−373) and document.test.ts (−426). In the offer tests, `target="_top"[^>]*>` becomes `target="_top">`, which drops the CTA attribute assertions. The '406 tests green / typecheck 0' evidence in goal.md cannot belong to this tree, because the tests it names (e.g. EXPECTED_CTA_SECTIONS in marketing-render.test.ts) exist only at the base.
findings.fix: Re-point the review and PR at the actual prd-3672-offer-page-name branch, rebased on main (it should contain 4bdce06aa7), and regenerate the diff. Do not ship 6fbfb05e2f against this base.

findings.title: offerAccepted carries no `section`, and no `ticket` CtaSection exists — none of the goal's correctness criteria hold at HEAD
findings.body: In `press()` at HEAD, the payload is `{ offerKey, company?, amazonStoreKey? }` (lines 489–495; amazon-checkup-offer.tsx ~508 is the same). It never reads the pressed button's `data-cta-section`. The gift ticket, store block and closing band therefore all send identical `offerAccepted` events, so PRD-3672 (tell which Start button was pressed) is not delivered. The buttons themselves have no `data-cta-section` at HEAD: GiftTicket renders `<a className='so-gift-go' data-offer-go='' href='#start' target='_top'>`. `CTA_SECTIONS` doesn't exist anywhere in console/components/marketing at HEAD (`git grep` finds nothing), so `ticket` is not a valid CtaSection. Neither `internal-dev-doc/posthog-session-replay.md` nor `.claude/skills/offer-pages/SKILL.md` mentions `offerAccepted` at HEAD, so the doc criterion isn't met either.
findings.fix: Review the commit that actually implements PRD-3672: add `ticket` to CTA_SECTIONS, add `ctaAttrs('accept-offer', 'ticket'|'hero')` on the ticket and store buttons, and set `accepted.section = go.getAttribute('data-cta-section')` in `press()` on both pages.

findings.title: Удалены проверки, которые обнаруживают потерю CTA-разметки
findings.body: В фактическом диапазоне из scope.md удалены тесты `marks every tracked marketing interaction as a CTA` и `has its approved CTA identity`. Одновременно обе offer-страницы теряют `data-cta` и `data-cta-section`; сохранённый первый тест обнаружил бы кнопки `[data-offer-go]` без CTA-имени. Замены этим проверкам в console нет, а оставшаяся проверка совпадения HTML с компонентами принимает согласованно сломанную разметку. Это введённая диапазоном потеря защиты контракта: goal.md требует сохранить согласованность `ctaClicked`, а не удалить её проверку.
findings.fix: Вернуть проверки CTA-разметки и обновить ожидаемые секции согласно задаче: ticket, hero и close-band.
